python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, json
src='/app/main.db'
out='/app/recovered.json'
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{src}?mode=ro', uri=True)
rows=con.execute('SELECT id, name, value FROM inventory ORDER BY id').fetchall()
con.close()
records=[{'id': int(i), 'name': str(n), 'value': int(v)} for i,n,v in rows]
with open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(records, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(f'Wrote {len(records)} base-snapshot records to {out}')
print(json.dumps(records, indent=2))
PY
